fee_notes: Uniform $35,000 fee paid in lump sum at signing. Additional $4,000 initial training fee required. Area Development Agreement uses $35,000 for first store and $30,000 per additional store.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee is $35,000 and must be paid in full in one lump sum, by wire transfer or other method designated by us, when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
